description: Ganoderma / BSR two-class offline training dataset manifest

sources.name: Oil Palm Ganoderma Infected Dataset
sources.notes: Ganoderma=1 or Ganoderma Fungus=1 maps to suspected_risk. Source page, version, and license are intentionally not tracked in Git for this pass.

sources.name: Oil Palm Healthy Dataset
sources.notes: healthy=1 maps to healthy; unhealthy=1 maps to suspected_risk. Source page, version, and license are intentionally not tracked in Git for this pass.

label_notes: v1 trains healthy and suspected_risk only. other_stress_unknown is reserved for future data. suspected_risk is a risk-screening class, not confirmed disease.

split_strategy.constraint: No tree, plantation, source, or capture-batch grouping was available for v1.
split_strategy.notes: The two Roboflow source importers split their own rows by class and append into the same classification directory. This is a random baseline and does not rule out source, tree, or capture-batch leakage.

known_risks: healthy and suspected_risk samples come from different Roboflow projects
suspected_risk samples include trunk-base/root and trunk views, while healthy samples are trunk views
cross-dataset duplicate detection was not performed
same-tree and same-capture-batch leakage cannot be ruled out
domain bias may inflate test performance
notes: This manifest records the actual v1 offline training handoff facts.
The model output must be interpreted as suspected risk, never confirmed disease.
If a runtime workflow later uses a confirmed status, that status is user-review state, not agronomic diagnosis.
